name: Picture Day
source:
You play as a photographer, one of two in a particular town. Your business competition is out of town for a while thus you've got some more clients, and as always, you'll strive to get the best picture for your client.

[From [url=https://fluffy-plant.itch.io/picture-day]itch.io[/url]]
